messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up: the TypeScript example in sample-app/README.md used a default import that breaks in strict ESM TS projects (no esModuleInterop). Users hit `TypeError: Redwood is not a constructor` at runtime after tsc.

Liam O'Connor: Oof. Paste the snippet?

Maya Chen: Current README shows:
```ts
import Redwood from 'redwood-inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
```

Maya Chen: But our package exposes a named factory: `export function createClient(...)`. Correct usage is:
```ts
import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference';
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
```

Sophia Patel: I tripped over this when trying the quickstart with an ESM-first template. Error message is pretty opaque for newcomers. We should stop relying on consumers toggling tsconfig flags.

Maya Chen: Proposed fix: 1) update README to use named import; 2) add CJS + ESM variants for JS copy/paste; 3) short FAQ/Troubleshooting note about tsconfig `esModuleInterop` and why we prefer named exports. I'll open a PR.

Liam O'Connor: Also add a tiny CI smoke test: npm pack the package, build the sample TS ESM project and run it with node. Catch these copy/paste regressions early.

doc-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/512 — "sample-app README: switch to named createClient import + FAQ note"

Maya Chen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/948 — README update, JS/CJS examples, FAQ, and a small CI step.

ci-bot: CI started for docs/pr-948 — lint and smoke checks running.

Sophia Patel: Can you also add a one-liner in the internal onboarding checklist so SEs don't hit this during demos? I'll update the checklist when PR merges.

Maya Chen: Yep added that to PR description. CI lint passed, smoke test failing due to sample-app build path, pushing a fix for tsconfig outDir.

Liam O'Connor: Nice. After merge, let's add a doc snippet in the SDK changelog noting the export style, so SDK users scanning releases won't be surprised.

Maya Chen: CI now green. Merged to main and backported to devex/docs branch. Updated Confluence onboarding checklist. Thanks for quick reviews!

ci-bot: CI completed — all checks passed for docs/pr-948.
